failure_criteria: no canonical weak solution can be constructed independently of Lprime and the certified packet
the admissible feature matrix is underdetermined by the controls
a route-dependent feature changes while the packet defect must remain invariant
the frozen formula fails one certified control or one untouched holdout

required_symmetries: invariant under inversion of the quartic generator after the corresponding Artin relabeling
invariant across two certified CM routes for the same original packet

holdout.acceptance: every certified ball for the phase defect contains the exact congruence class predicted before opening the target
